title: Aqeedah Series by Ustadh Tim Humble
description: A comprehensive series on Islamic creed (Aqeedah عقيدة) covering the six articles of faith, the pillars of Islam, and the foundations of the Salafi methodology. Taught by Ustadh Muhammad Tim Humble with clear explanations based on the understanding of the Salaf.
short_description: Comprehensive Aqeedah course based on the understanding of the Salaf

modules.title: Foundations of Islamic Creed
modules.description: Understanding the core beliefs of Ahlus-Sunnah wal-Jama'ah.

lessons.title: What is Aqeedah?
lessons.content: An introduction to the science of Aqeedah (عقيدة) - its meaning, importance, and why every Muslim must have knowledge of correct Islamic belief.

lessons.title: Belief in Allah
lessons.content: Understanding the first article of faith: belief in Allah (الإيمان بالله) - His lordship, names, attributes, and right to be worshipped alone.

lessons.title: Belief in the Angels
lessons.content: Understanding the second article of faith: belief in the angels (الإيمان بالملائكة) - their nature, functions, and hierarchy.

lessons.title: Belief in the Divine Books
lessons.content: Understanding the third article of faith: belief in the divine books (الإيمان بالكتب) - their revelation, preservation, and the abrogation of previous scriptures.

modules.title: The Articles of Faith Continued
modules.description: Completing the six articles of faith and understanding their implications.

lessons.title: Belief in the Messengers
lessons.content: Understanding the fourth article of faith: belief in the prophets and messengers (الإيمان بالرسل) - their mission, characteristics, and the finality of Prophet Muhammad (صلّ الله عليه وسلّم).

lessons.title: Belief in the Last Day
lessons.content: Understanding the fifth article of faith: belief in the Day of Judgment (الإيمان بيوم الآخر) - its events, signs, and what awaits mankind.

lessons.title: Belief in Divine Decree
lessons.content: Understanding the sixth article of faith: belief in Al-Qadr (الإيمان بالقضاء والقدر) - divine decree, predestination, and free will.

lessons.title: The Pillars of Islam
lessons.content: Understanding the five pillars of Islam (أركان الإسلام) and their connection to correct Aqeedah.

modules.title: The Salafi Methodology
modules.description: Understanding how correct Aqeedah translates into practice.

lessons.title: Who are the Salaf?
lessons.content: Understanding the term Salaf (السلف) - the righteous predecessors - and why their methodology is the criterion for correctness.

lessons.title: Avoiding Innovation (Bid'ah)
lessons.content: Understanding the danger of Bid'ah (بدعة) - religious innovation - and how to guard the religion from fabricated practices.

lessons.title: Following the Sunnah
lessons.content: The importance of adhering to the Sunnah (السنة) of the Prophet (صلّ الله عليه وسلّم) in matters of worship and daily life.

lessons.title: The Saved Sect
lessons.content: Understanding the prophetic description of the saved sect (الفرقة الناجية) and how to be upon the correct methodology.
